did: I turned the public Pages site into a CV, as the owner asked. Pages is now static pages only: a landing drawn from the résumé's data, the résumé as HTML with a page and a PDF for each version, the record each video's end card links to, and a 404 page. It went from 5.3 MB and about 270 files to under 1 MB, with no app. The landing's slots show real clips and stills when CI has made them: Page Filter's gap, shot on a page of ours, Suspender Ledger's promo, and the phone app's Jobs walk, all on sample data. Each deploy fetches the newest of each from main's own runs, and draws a placeholder when one is missing. The work landed through the coordinator's buckets, PRs 3410, 3412 and 3416, each branch reviewed fresh before it went in. After the merge, Site Assets made the Page Filter still and the extensions clip on its first run. Snips Capture failed before taking any screen, because an earlier change made its specs load JSON that Node refuses without a type; I fixed that on its own branch, with a test that holds it. Later the same day, the landing's clips became the cards' backgrounds, as the owner asked. Each clip plays silent and on a loop behind its card's words, with nothing to click or pause, and anyone who prefers less motion sees the card's drawing instead. Every card takes the exact shape of its clip or still, read from the file when the site is built, so nothing is cropped or padded, and a card grows below its picture rather than cut off its words. The clips are made without sound, and a build refuses one that has any. The per-card source links are gone; the code is one link away at the top of the page. The photo slot's mochi is now drawn from the same source as the video thumbnails (PR 3420).

calls.title: The public site serves static pages and no app; the résumé reads as HTML with a PDF download
options: keep the app on Pages for the résumé and the authorship record
static pages that embed the PDF on a desktop
static pages in HTML at every width, with the PDF a download
calls.why: A CV needs no app, and the HTML reads on a phone and is found by search; the PDF stays one click away for each version.
calls.undo: Give the Pages build the app's index.html entry again and write it as 404.html.

calls.title: How the landing's clips and stills reach the Pages build
options: an artifact per kind, made by CI on sample data and fetched at each deploy
media pinned by commit in paulgsc/testing
everything rendered inside the Pages workflow
calls.why: It commits no media and needs no storage, and a missing piece only shows its drawing.
calls.undo: Delete the Site Assets workflow, the APK clip job and the Pages fetch step; every slot draws its placeholder.

calls.title: The desktop strip stops claiming the Practice and Jobs wings publish anything
options: name the essays' snips as where they go public
leave them until the owner says
calls.why: Pages no longer carries those screens, so the lines claimed a publication that isn't there.
calls.undo: Bring the Published field and line back from git history, then give the wings their lines.

calls.title: The landing's clips get the browser's own controls
options: a poster still played on a tap
calls.why: Anyone can pause a looping clip, someone who prefers less motion included, and the page still runs no script.
calls.undo: Drop controls from the clip's video tag.

left: Checking the live site after the next deploy: it waits on the owner's approval of the Pages release, and the steps are written on epic 3401.
Home's dashboard pictures for the landing were built by another worker on the owner's yes to ask 3415; they wait on the owner's keys (ask 3423) after the next home deploy.
The photo slot still holds the mochi until the owner adds a portrait.
Archiving this session: the environment refused it, so it stays with the owner or the coordinator.
